inputs.caseName: Reference example: 100 Hz sine dwell / 90-110 Hz random
inputs.basis: Irvine (2011), random_sine_rainflow.pdf, second method: 1 g peak at 100 Hz for 30 s; 0.03 g^2/Hz from 90 to 110 Hz for 30 s; Q=10, b=4. The tool uses relative displacement and stationary spectral expected damage. Compare like-for-like with FLife; the published acceleration rainflow sample is not an exact target.
